project_info.name: DutchBay Wind Farm
project_info.location: Dutch Bay, Kalpitiya, Puttalam District, Sri Lanka

notes: Net AEP for the 15 x IEA Reference 10MW (198 m, 345 W/m2) re-model via wind_resource.bankable_aep: IEC 61400-12-1 air-density correction (rho 1.15, v-shift x0.979) of the IEA power curve over DECLARED Weibull A=8.32/k=2.1; PyWake Bastankhah-Porte-Agel 2014 granular wake = 7.28% (TurbOPark bound 8.93%) over a 15-turbine 650 m row; availability/electrical/curtailment/other = 14.48% total losses; P50/P75/P90 from an IEC 61400-15-2 uncertainty budget (sigma ~10%). 15 x 10.638 = 159.6 MW nameplate, net CF 0.346. Supersedes the EN-171/6.5 base (402.6 GWh / 0.307); EN-171 retained as a characterization/sensitivity machine. Declared Weibull pending live ARCO ERA5 refresh.
